text: NASA spent over two years catching pieces of the Sun. Then it dropped them on Utah at three hundred kilometres an hour.
The Genesis capsule collected solar wind in deep space and brought it home in two thousand four. A parachute was supposed to open on the way down.
The trigger was a tiny gravity switch that senses the capsule slowing down. It was installed upside down. A test would have caught it. The test was skipped.
No parachute. The capsule hit the desert and cracked open. Scientists still saved some of the samples.
